name: Abu Dhabi
housing: Abu Dhabi renters live in apartment towers on the main island and Al Reem, and in villas and townhouses in the suburbs.

localRules.text: Tenancy contracts in Abu Dhabi must be registered on Tawtheeq, and a rental dispute cannot be filed without it.

climate: Test every air conditioning unit; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair.
fact: Abu Dhabi's tenancy registration system is called Tawtheeq.
